ja252:1.1: Ajjāpi me taṃ manasi yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ tilamuṭṭhiyā bāhāya maṃ gahetvāna laṭṭhiyā anutāḷayi.
ja252:2.1: Nanu jīvitena ramasi yenāsi brāhmaṇāgato yaṃ maṃ bāhā gahetvāna tikkhattuṃ anutāḷayīti.
ja252:3.1: Ariyo anariyaṃ kubbānaṃ yo daṇḍena nisedhati sāsanatthaṃ na taṃ veraṃ, iti naṃ paṇḍitā vidū ti.
